## 结果文件解压方法

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
data <- read.delim('src/file_decompress.xls')
kable(data,table.attr = "class=\"nowrap\"","html",align="c") %>%
kable_styling(full_width=T)  %>%
column_spec(1,bold=T) %>%
collapse_rows(columns=1:2)
```

## 结果文件格式说明

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
data <- read.delim('src/file_format.xls')
kable(data,table.attr = "class=\"nowrap\"","html",align="c") %>%
kable_styling(full_width=T) %>%
column_spec(1,bold=T) %>%
collapse_rows(columns=1:2)
```

## 分析软件列表及版本

```{r echo=FALSE}///ref3v2
library(knitr)///ref3v2
data <- read.delim('src/ref_software_list.xls',sep='\t',header=T)///ref3v2
kable(data, table.attr = "class=\"nowrap\"","html",align="c") %>%///ref3v2
kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped", "hover","condensed","responsive") , full_width = F) %>%///ref3v2
column_spec(1,bold=T) %>%///ref3v2
collapse_rows(columns=1:2)///ref3v2
```///ref3v2
